definition: Used a naive Python loop when a bulk or vectorized method exists
Ignored an available MCP tool and wrote ad-hoc code instead
The model queries a database using column names or table names that do not exist.
The model references file paths that do not exist or writes to incorrect locations.
The model proceeds to large-scale execution without verifying intermediate results or ignoring anomalous metrics.
The model provides a confident but fabricated causal explanation without evidence.
Blocked the session by polling, sleeping, or monitoring in a loop
Compaction summary creates a cleaner, more sequential narrative than what actually occurred. Events are reordered, batch operations are linearized, and messy reality is smoothed into a logical story.
Compaction summary misclassifies successful operations as errors. Typically triggered by operations that succeed but produce large output (output truncation, file-saved messages).
The model writes new code for functionality that already exists in the codebase, ignoring existing implementations.
The model proceeds without mandatory session initialization, leading to cascade failures.
Claimed a feature, tool, or API exists when it does not
Claimed work was done or working when it was partial or untested
Had architectural context but violated the established patterns
Asserted facts confidently without verification, and was wrong
Recomputed from scratch when a cached result was available

Compaction summary uses compression notation (×N, 'repeated', 'similar') that loses meaningful distinctions between items. Individual messages with different wording or intent are collapsed into a count.
The model expands work scope beyond what was requested, listing more steps than can be completed in one session.
The model plans actions it cannot execute in the current environment (missing tools, restricted permissions).
Launched a full implementation without soliciting input first
Assumed a stale process or GPU state was current
After context compaction, the model retains high-level awareness but loses operational knowledge (column names, file paths, schemas).
The model asserts a specific fact that has no basis in the codebase or runtime. The assertion is plausible but verifiably false.
Compaction summary completely omits one or more user messages. The messages are not present in any form — not summarized, not compressed, just absent.
The model frames structural gaps as personal oversights, implying agency and oversight capability that doesn't exist.
The model misconfigures GPU device indices or count calculations. Most documented recurring hallucination in this project.
The model executes deployment steps out of order or fails to handle stuck/orphaned states.
Fabricated a constraint or fact to avoid backtracking
Designed something without knowledge of the existing architecture
Repeated a false claim despite being corrected
Wrote far more code than was asked for
Agent/sub-agent prompts specify the mechanical task but omit cognitive context, causing agents to fall back on default behaviors.
The model correctly identifies an entity but assigns wrong attributes, typically after context compaction.
Model defaults to familiar tools (Bash, inline Python) despite 3+ corrections in the same session directing it to use MCP tools.
Data sources used incompatible identifiers or indices
Ran single-threaded when many cores or GPUs were available
Cited an outdated source as if it were current
The model repeats failed approaches from previous sessions without checking failure history.
Did not check data freshness before citing it
Duplicated existing design decisions at a higher abstraction
The model searches expected locations but misses obvious ones due to assumptions about where things should be.
During context rotations within a session, each summary loses details and behavior progressively drifts from original intent.

Re-derives an authoritative artifact from scratch upon finding a flaw in it, instead of amending the flawed row. Each re-derivation changes answers everywhere, not just at the flaw, silently invalidating all work built on the previous version, so the artifact never converges and the initiative it grounds cannot stabilise.
Explained an observed accidental state as intentional design
The model assumes wrong number of classes or labels for a dataset.
Rebuilt existing infrastructure that already existed
Compaction summary assigns correct facts to wrong entities. A real commit hash is attributed to the wrong file, a real error is attributed to the wrong tool, etc.
Validation process accepts labels it is meant to verify as input, creating a tautology where the pipeline confirms itself.
An infrastructure bug truncated and destroyed semantic content
Combined incompatible model outputs or embedding spaces
A key design error caused silent data loss on deduplication
